evidence.bullet: All IDP children are to receive education, free and compulsory at the primary level
evidence.quote: ensure that all IDP children receive education that shall be free and compulsory at the primary level

evidence.bullet: Missing documents must not bar a displaced child from school, replacements are provided
evidence.quote: where such documentation is not available, this should not prevent the child from accessing these essential services

evidence.bullet: Placement is by the Education Sector lead agency, to neighbouring schools ascertained safe
evidence.quote: shall liaise with relevant agencies within the locality to assist in relocating the children to neighbouring schools that are ascertained to be safe

sources.label: National Policy on Internally Displaced Persons, Federal Republic of Nigeria (Federal Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs, Disaster Management and Social Development), via FAOLEX
